visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Dropdown that sends the wrong value
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The user picks Team, but the form would send pro, the value of the Pro option. Two options have the same value, so the page cannot tell them apart.

solution.explanation: The value attribute is what the form sends. Every option needs its own value, or choosing one looks the same as choosing another.

checks.label: The options have different values
checks.expr: (() => { var v = [].map.call(document.querySelectorAll('#plan option'), function (o) { return o.value; }); return new Set(v).size === v.length; })()

checks.label: Choosing Team gives its own value
checks.expr: (() => { var s = document.querySelector('#plan'); s.selectedIndex = 2; return s.value === 'team'; })()
